description: This file defines an Android Activity class 'Intents' that handles user interactions (via button clicks) to launch system dialog to choose music, images, or generic streams using intents.

classes.name: Intents
classes.description: An Android Activity that provides methods for launching content chooser dialogs for music, images, and streams.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity and sets the content view.

methods.name: onGetMusic
methods.description: Launches a chooser to select music files.

methods.name: onGetImage
methods.description: Launches a chooser to select image files.

methods.name: onGetStream
methods.description: Launches a chooser to select any type of stream.
